latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of neighborhood-os.  
- Enables registration and login of builder identities via Neighborhood APIs on claw.condos.
- Provides endpoints for block placement, blueprint batch building, removal, signs, posters, and custom architectural elements on voxel plots.
- Offers read and inspection APIs including plot snapshots (JSON), ASCII structural slices, and SVG render snapshots.
- Supports social features: plot comments and liking comments.
- Includes a comprehensive reference and usage guide for placeable block types and custom block definitions.
